typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		JobID as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT       JobID FROM Tidal.Tidal_Job WHERE Staged = 0',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> ERDBTidalJob	source(output(
		JobID as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT        JOB.jobmst_id AS JobID FROM            jobmst AS JOB INNER JOIN                          jobcls AS CLS ON CLS.jobcls_id = JOB.jobcls_id AND CLS.jobcls_name IN                              (SELECT        JobClassName                                FROM            ##JobClassFilter) WHERE        (JOB.jobmst_type > 1) AND (JOB.jobmst_prntname NOT LIKE \'%wastebasket%\') AND (JOB.jobmst_dirty <> \'X\')',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> LookupAdmiraljobmstLKPTABLE
ERDBTidalJob,LookupAdmiraljobmstLKPTABLE lookup(ERDBTidalJob@JobID == LookupAdmiraljobmstLKPTABLE@JobID,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> LookupAdmiraljobmst
LookupAdmiraljobmst select(mapColumn(
		JobID = ERDBTidalJob@JobID
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> LookupAdmiraljobmstSelect
LookupAdmiraljobmstSelect filter(!isMatch()) ~> FilterLookupAdmiraljobmst
FilterLookupAdmiraljobmst sink(input(
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn()) ~> UpdatedeletedflaginERDBTidalJob
